key_terms.المْ: Disjointed letters (Alif, Lam, Mim) appearing at the beginning of certain Quranic surahs.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the letters Alif Lam Mim at the start of Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the disjointed letters (al-Huruf al-Muqatta'at) at the start of Surah Ar-Rum are often viewed as a divine mystery (ghayb) that underscores the inimitability (i'jaz) of the Quran, challenging both Arabs and Persians to match its eloquence. This surah specifically addresses the historical context of the Byzantine-Sasanian wars, offering reassurance to the early Muslims that the Romans' eventual victory would be a sign of God's power, thereby linking historical events to spiritual truth.
